policy.test_visible_rule: n_txn_<split> >= 1; scored members = union(from_id, to_id) over the ring's pattern lines in <split> only
policy.strict_rule: n_txn_<split> == n_txn and n_txn > 0; full membership

ceiling.c_definition: (c) counts in-scope-ring members by FULL membership that have no test-period transaction at all, i.e. cannot be recovered from test evidence; 'unrecoverable' additionally counts members whose every test transaction is labelled licit
